summary: Comprehensive testing of SEO, images, and schema features. All 17 backend tests passed. integration_issues.issue: Event cards on homepage still show Pexels URLs (from event_image field in API) instead of local /images/heroes/ WebP images. The getEventImagePath() function is used but the event_image from API takes precedence.

action_items: MEDIUM: Event card images still using Pexels URLs from API event_image field. The HomePage EventCard component uses event.event_image as fallback src which comes from database. Either: 1) Update seed data to remove external URLs, or 2) Modify EventCard to ignore event_image and always use getEventImagePath()
